Notification
Date.17/07/2026
Advertisement for the post of Research Assistant in ICPR Funded Project
Applications are invited for the recruitment of 01 Research Assistant to work on the Project entitled
“Socio-Economic and Political Philosophy of Acharya Nagarjuna: A critical study in the light of
Present Time” funded by ICPR, New Delhi. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the
Project
The detailed of the position with eligibility criteria are mentioned below

Interested and eligible applications may send their CV along with all testimonials and a covering letter to
the Principal Investigator through e-mail on chintala@gbu.ac.in or ncym2040@gmail.com latest by 1st,
August, 2026.
Note: The Candidate will be short-listed initially based on their qualifications and work experience, and
only the short-listed candidates be called for the interview.
*No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview
*For further enquiries contact the Project Director @+91 8130084839
Date of the Interview: 8th August, 2026 (Tentatively)
Time: 10.00 AM onwards
Venue: International Affairs Office, Administrative Building, GBU
